text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute ran splendidly to the finish. 
After the race, however, she made a firm 
resolution.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Retirement. Now that she had given hope 
to those striving to rise again and felt 
her own strength waning, she thought now 
was the time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The exhaustion from giving her all in the 
Kawasaki Kinen runs deep. Yet, is it 
really fine to end it like this?— The 
Trainer suggests continuing just a little 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In response to her Trainer's request, she 
decided to run in next month's Teio Sho.
